item.title: Kubernetes Community Day Kochi 2026 — Organizer
item.description:
Organized the first-ever Kubernetes Community Day Kochi under the official CNCF umbrella — after 3 consecutive years of pushing to make it happen.

  • 400+ registrations
  • 170+ CFPs
  • 40+ speakers
  • 7 sponsors, 7+ community partners

item.title: AWS Community Day Kochi — Organizer
item.description: One of India’s flagship AWS community events. Five editions organized across seven consecutive years — bringing world-class speakers, hands-on workshops, and the cloud community together in Kochi.

item.title: AWS Community Day South Asia — Virtual Edition — Co-Organizer
item.description: Co-organized the AWS Community Day South Asia virtual edition — expanding the community reach across the South Asian region.

item.title: AWS Container Hero
item.description: Recognized as an AWS Container Hero since 2021 for contributions to the AWS and Kubernetes community. Speaker, trainer, and hackathon judge at various cloud and DevOps events.

item.title: AWS Community Day India — Virtual Edition — Co-Organizer
item.description: Co-organized the virtual edition of AWS Community Day India during the pandemic — bringing the AWS community together online when in-person events weren’t possible.

item.title: CNCG Kochi Chapter - Organizer
item.description:
Organizing the Cloud Native Computing Foundation Kochi Chapter since 2020. Bringing together developers, architects, and enthusiasts interested in cloud native technologies.

  • Regular meetups on Cloud Native Projects, Best Practices, and BoF Chats
  • Organizer of Kubernetes Community Day Kochi 2026
  • Visit Community Page

item.title: AWS User Group Kochi - Organizer
item.description:
Organizing the AWS User Group Kochi since 2017. A community of AWS users and enthusiasts focused on sharing knowledge, best practices, and experiences with Amazon Web Services.

  • Organizer of AWS Community Day Kochi 2019, 2022, 2023, 2024, 2025
  • Regular meetups and workshops
  • Visit Meetup Page
